cover_headline: Ramayana Posts Record Second Friday, Second-Biggest Ever for a Hindi Film
facts: Ramayana: Part One collected approximately Rs 47 crore nett across India on its second Friday — the highest second-Friday figure recorded at the Indian box office
The Hindi version netted Rs 36 crore on the day, the second-biggest second Friday for a Hindi film, behind Dhurandhar: The Revenge at Rs 36.50 crore
The Hindi total reached about Rs 465 crore nett after nine days, after a drop of just 12% from the previous day

end.headline: Ramayana Posts Record Second Friday, Second-Biggest Ever for a Hindi Film
end.line: Nitesh Tiwari's epic took the all-India second-Friday record, with its Hindi version second only to Dhurandhar: The Revenge.
